# Rivergate

A fortified town at the confluence of the [[Blackwater]] and the [[Thorn]]. The
toll-collector is [[Garros Ironbar|the toll-collector]].

## What is known

- The walls are old, and older than the town they enclose.
- There are two bridges. One of them is newer than the war.

> [!warning] The winter
> The winter is not discussed further here.
